source_review.title: Time-restricted eating and metabolic health: a systematic review and meta-analysis

conclusion_summary: Time-restricted eating shows metabolic benefits in some studies but results are inconsistent; evidence quality is moderate.
limitations: High heterogeneity across intervention protocols (16:8 vs 20:4 etc)

quantitative_claims.claim: 3-4% reduction in fat mass with 16:8 TRE
4-7 mmHg reduction in systolic blood pressure
